findings.description: The KMS customer-managed key is created without enable_key_rotation, so automatic rotation of the cryptographic key material is disabled (the inline comment confirms this). Without rotation, a compromised key remains valid indefinitely, weakening the organization's ability to recover from key compromise and failing the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark control requiring rotation for customer-created CMKs.
